replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Your map has been denied and will not appear in the Avicus repository or rotations for the following reasons:

- Awkward placement of structures (iron farms, etc). I advise that you move the iron farms closer to spawn or on a connecting path from spawn to the farms. As it is right now, it would be difficult to bridge back and forth. gameplay factor

- Un-needed patterns in certain areas (right before the front-lines). Removing the floor designs that are in front of spawn would look better with the map and fit it's style. Although this isn't a huge factor, it stills improves the map's quality. aesthetics factor

Overall, the map isn't bad and it could definitely be improved. You may update this thread with the improved map version when you have fixed the problems.

Good luck and have a wonderful day!
